# Jose M. Vidal - Computer Science, University of South Carolina

> Research and educational resources on multiagent systems, distributed algorithms, and agent-based simulations from a University of South Carolina computer science professor.

Jose M. Vidal is a computer science researcher and educator specializing in multiagent systems, distributed artificial intelligence, and agent-based modeling. This site serves as a repository for his academic publications, course materials, and interactive NetLogo simulations demonstrating key concepts in multiagent systems and distributed algorithms.

## Key Topics

- Multiagent Systems
- Distributed Algorithms
- NetLogo
- Agent-Based Simulation
- Vehicle Platooning
- Ad-hoc Networks
- Distributed Artificial Intelligence
- Supply Chain Simulation
- Port Simulation
- Traffic Congestion
- Computational Framework
- Theory Construction
- Algorithm Demonstrations
- Research Publications
- Fundamentals of Multiagent Systems

## Research & Publications

- [Jose M. Vidal's Publications](https://jmvidal.cse.sc.edu/papers/index.html): Comprehensive index of Jose M. Vidal's research publications on multiagent systems and vehicle platooning
- [Jose M Vidal - Curriculum Vitae](https://jmvidal.cse.sc.edu/papers/cv.html): Jose M. Vidal's curriculum vitae and academic profile from University of South Carolina

## Educational Resources & Courses

- [Distributed Artificial Intelligence and Multiagent Systems (EECE 822)](https://jmvidal.cse.sc.edu/822/winter99/index.html): EECE 822 graduate course syllabus on distributed AI and multiagent systems fundamentals

## Interactive Simulations & Models

- [Multiagent NetLogo Models](https://jmvidal.cse.sc.edu/netlogomas): NetLogo-based multiagent system models demonstrating distributed algorithms and simulations
